title: Add observability alerts for onboarding telemetry regressions (missing events, pipeline lag, step drop-offs)
creator: Nadia Rahman
description:
Background
- Guided onboarding checklist beta is feature-flagged and relies on onboarding telemetry events emitted from Console + backend for:
  (1) funnel measurement, (2) step validation signals, and (3) product decisions on step ordering/copy.
- During early beta we saw one-region gaps due to an instrumentation deploy ordering issue; this ticket adds durable alerting so we catch regressions quickly before they skew funnel metrics or break checklist validation.

Problem
We currently detect telemetry issues mostly via ad-hoc dashboard checks. We need proactive alerting for:
1) Missing onboarding events (by region / environment / app version)
2) Pipeline delays (event_time -> ingest_time, plus dataset freshness)
3) Sudden drop-offs in key completion steps that indicate a regression (e.g., event name typo, gating bug, dedupe key issue)

Scope
- Alerts are for telemetry health and “data quality”, not for user-facing API uptime.
- Applies to onboarding checklist events (schema v1) emitted from:
  - Console web app
  - Console backend
- Must not require logging prompt/customer content; operate only on allowed event properties + counts/latency.

Proposed alert set (v1)
A) Missing events (ingestion)
- Alert when total count of onboarding events falls below an expected baseline per region.
- Primary signals:
  - onboarding_event_total{env=prod, region, event_name}
  - unique_orgs_reporting{env=prod, region}
- Strategy:
  - Use ratio to total Console pageviews to avoid paging on low-traffic periods.
  - Alert only when both are true:
    1) onboarding_event_total / console_pageview_total drops below threshold
    2) absolute onboarding_event_total is below minimum count

B) Pipeline lag / freshness
- Alert when p95(event_ingest_time - event_client_time) exceeds threshold for >N minutes.
- Alert when datasets are stale:
  - “latest_partition_timestamp” (warehouse) older than threshold.

C) Step-specific drop-offs (regression detector)
- Key canary events for checklist:
  - onboarding.checklist_viewed
  - onboarding.step_completed (for step_id=first_successful_request)
  - onboarding.step_completed (for step_id=first_streaming_session)
  - onboarding.api_key_created (if emitted)
- Alert when conversion rates deviate sharply day-over-day for the same cohorting dimension (new_org=true) and region.
- Guardrails:
  - Do not page on expected product changes (feature flag ramp) — gate with feature_flag_exposure_rate and “flag on” denominator.
  - Require minimum denominator to avoid noisy paging.

Thresholds (initial; tune after 1 week)
- Missing events:
  - WARN: onboarding_event_total / console_pageview_total < 0.20 for 30m AND onboarding_event_total < 200 in same window
  - PAGE: onboarding_event_total / console_pageview_total < 0.10 for 30m AND onboarding_event_total < 200
- Lag:
  - WARN: p95 lag > 3m for 30m
  - PAGE: p95 lag > 10m for 30m OR warehouse freshness > 30m
- Drop-offs:
  - WARN: step conversion rate down > 35% vs trailing 7d baseline (same weekday) for 2h with denom >= 200
  - PAGE: step conversion rate down > 55% vs baseline for 2h with denom >= 200

Paging policy / ownership
- Paging target: Telemetry on-call (Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman rotation) during beta + first 2 weeks of GA.
- After GA stabilization: convert most to WARN + Slack channel unless customer-impacting (e.g., validators rely on it).

Implementation notes
- Metrics emitted from the telemetry ingestion service and the event validation pipeline, not from raw warehouse queries.
- For conversion/drop-off alerts, compute with a lightweight streaming aggregate (5m buckets) rather than warehouse batch jobs to reduce detection time.
- Ensure dashboards link from every alert to:
  - region breakdown
  - event_name breakdown
  - top app versions
  - recent deploy markers (Console + backend)

Acceptance criteria
- Alerts exist for missing events, pipeline lag, and step drop-offs as described above.
- Alerts are active in prod and scoped to onboarding telemetry only.
- Each alert includes:
  - clear title + runbook link
  - example dashboard link
  - recommended first 3 debugging steps
- A test plan is documented and executed (synthetic event pause / replay in staging).
- Post-deploy: at least one week of tuning documented (threshold adjustments + which alerts are noisy).

Out of scope
- Alerts for Dedicated/Private onboarding.
- Alerts on every single onboarding event name (we’ll start with a small canary set).

Risks / open questions
- Feature flag ramp changes denominators; ensure alert logic gates on exposure.
- Expected day-of-week traffic variability; baseline logic needs weekday-aware comparison.
- How much should we rely on client_time vs server_time when client clocks skew? (Mitigation: compute lag using server-received timestamp where available.)
acceptance_criteria: Create production alerts for (1) missing onboarding events, (2) telemetry pipeline lag/freshness, (3) step conversion drop-offs, each with runbook + dashboards linked.
Alerts use feature-flag exposure as denominator to avoid false positives during ramp.
Paging policy documented and agreed with DevEx + SRE for beta/GA.
Staging validation performed: synthetic pause/replay triggers WARN and PAGE as expected.
Threshold tuning notes added after first week of beta/GA traffic.
implementation_summary: Implemented telemetry health metrics and alert hooks (Datadog monitors) for onboarding events. Added region + app_version breakdown dashboards and linked them from monitor notifications. Conversion-rate monitors are gated on feature_flag_exposure_rate and minimum denominators to reduce noise. Runbook updated with first-response steps (check deploy markers, compare regions, validate allowlist/redaction changes, verify ingestion queue depth).
testing_notes: Staging test performed by disabling Console event emission for 20 minutes (feature flag off + synthetic traffic). Missing-event WARN fired within 35 minutes; PAGE fired after threshold reduction to 0.10 ratio. Lag alert validated by injecting 12-minute delay in staging ingestion worker; p95 lag PAGE fired within 30 minutes. Drop-off alert validated by emitting checklist_viewed without step_completed; WARN fired after 2h with denom threshold met.
rollout_notes: Enabled monitors in prod during beta (flag exposure ~10%). Initial tuning: raised minimum denominators from 100->200 to prevent low-traffic paging in EU-West overnight; adjusted WARN ratio threshold from 0.25->0.20 after observing normal variance. Kept PAGE thresholds conservative. After GA, plan is to keep lag/freshness as PAGE and downgrade drop-off monitors to WARN-only unless validators rely on the event.
